description: Election Commission - Mr. M. Mohomad of the Mihintale Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his  office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Mihintale Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for local authorities, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
